name: contextboard
description: Collaborative notes and action review workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
